info.name: CredVault — Password Manager API
info.description:
Every API behind the Kryptone CredVault prototype (Kryptone_CredVault_Prototype.html). Coverage, rules and test results: docs/CREDVAULT_API_SHEET.md.

BEFORE YOU START
1. Migrations: php artisan migrate (runs database/migrations/credvault).
2. Fill the variables: baseUrl, email/password (an employee), adminEmail/adminPassword (a client admin of the SAME company), managerEmail/managerPassword (the employee's reporting manager), recipientUserId (any other active user of the company).
3. Run 00 · Setup first, then the folders in order — later requests read ids saved by earlier ones.

RESPONSES
Success: { status: true, data, tabs?, meta? }. Refusal: { status: false, message, errors? } with errors keyed by field. 401 no token · 403 not allowed · 404 not found or out of reach · 409 state conflict · 410 import token used/expired · 422 validation · 423 credential locked / too many OTP attempts · 429 rate limit.

RATE LIMITS
240/min per user across CredVault · 60/min on reveal · 10/min on authenticator checks.

item.description: Log in three people. Most requests run as the requester ({{token}}). The approval steps run as the Vault Admin ({{adminToken}}) and the requester's reporting manager ({{managerToken}}). The share recipient must be an active user of the same company — put their user id in {{recipientUserId}}.

request.description: 404 until a recovery_key is saved on the credential.
POST, not PUT: PHP does not read multipart bodies on a PUT. Replace the document (files[file]), add extras (attachments[]), or drop one (remove_attachments[] = its key).

item.name: 05 · Critical Vault & Access Requests
item.description:
Run top to bottom. As in the prototype, the authenticator is linked inside the Add form: "New authenticator" returns a secret (saved as {{totpSecret}}), and the save sends it with one code — the pre-request scripts compute {{otpCode}}.

Flow: link app in the save → request → Vault Admin approves → Manager approves → OTP → unlocked for the window → lock.

item.name: 06 · Password Health
item.description: Weak, reused, 2FA off, rotation, over-shared — computed live from the vault and the policy. Fix an issue by editing the credential; the fix shows on the Resolved tab.

item.name: 07 · CredVault Policies
item.description: Everyone can read; only a Vault Admin can change. Send only the keys that change. Every change is logged with the old and new value.

item.name: Update — all critical checks off (allowed, with a warning)

    "rotation_default": 90,

    "gen_length": 20,

        "critical",

item.description: Import: preview (upload) → import the selected rows by index. Passwords stay on the server between the two calls; the token works once.\nBackup: CSV / JSON / Excel, optionally locked in an AES-256 zip.
